title: Personal Portfolio
description: My personal portfolio website built with React and Tailwind CSS.
extendedDescription: I built my personal portfolio website using React and Tailwind CSS, focusing on delivering a clean, modern, and responsive user experience. The site showcases my projects, skills, and professional background through a visually appealing layout powered by reusable React components and Tailwind's utility-first styling. By optimizing performance and ensuring seamless navigation across devices, the portfolio serves as an effective platform for presenting my work and personal brand.
